text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a technology that allows machines to think and learn like humans. It works mainly through machine learning, where computers improve by studying large amounts of data. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses artificial neural networks to solve very complex problems, such as recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. For example, it helps to recommend films and music, translates languages, and powers voice assistants on our phones. It is also used in medicine, banking, and transport. AI is changing the world quickly and making many tasks easier.
